response.original_title: Faqs ✦ How Can I Add Another Passenger to My Cunard Cruise?
response.overview: To add another Passenger to an existing Cunard Cruise 1-888-315-9585 reservation, you must book a separate new statePassenger and call Cunard Cruises customer service at +1-888-315-9585(US) or contact your travel agent to link the two bookings. Book a separate cabin: You cannot add a Passenger to an existing reservation through the online website or mobile app. Book a new statePassenger online or via phone. Contact Cunard Cruises at +1-888-315-9585(US) or your travel agent. You cannot directly add a new physical statePassenger to an existing reservation online; instead, you must book a separate Passenger and have it linked by calling Cunard Cruise customer service at +1-888 315-9585 or by contacting your travel advisor. To add an extra Passenger to an existing Cunard Cruise reservation, call Cunard Cruise at +1-888-315-9585
